# Du7 Technology Services

> Independent engineering business in the Netherlands (KVK 91476003), run by one
> engineer. It builds and runs two software products, rrbot.nl and Pauta, publishes
> open-source tools for IoT, cloud and automation, and takes engineering work on
> infrastructure, cloud and IoT, from Raspberry Pi to AWS. Contact: info@du7.dev.

## Products

- [rrbot.nl](https://rrbot.nl): WhatsApp trip log (Dutch "rittenregistratie") for
  people who drive a company car in the Netherlands, mainly holders of the
  "Verklaring geen privégebruik auto". One message per trip (odometer reading and
  destination); on request the bot sends a per-year Excel with the fields the
  Belastingdienst asks per trip. Paid subscription (monthly or yearly) with a 14-day
  free trial; VAT invoices per payment. Site in Dutch with an English version at
  /en/. The core is the open-source rittenregistratie-bot below. Not tax advice.
- [Pauta](https://www.pauta.cc): request queue ("fila de pedidos") for small
  Brazilian teams that run Meta ads for several clients. Each request has a
  briefing, budget and deadline and moves across a board; each client shows its
  Meta campaigns, ad balance and monthly payment. Passkey sign-in, by invitation.
  Web app in Brazilian Portuguese at app.pauta.cc; closed beta, no payments yet.
  Flat price per team planned.
- [Dominion Archive](https://dom.du7.dev): catalogue of every Dominion set and card
  with ratings and a public Game Night randomizer; with a passkey account it tracks
  owned printings, storage boxes and pull lists, and friends can rate by invite.
  Unofficial fan project; Dominion is a trademark of Rio Grande Games.

## Open source

- [rittenregistratie-bot](https://github.com/eduelias/rittenregistratie-bot):
  Self-hosted WhatsApp bot keeping a Belastingdienst-compliant car trip log in an
  append-only ledger; per-year Excel generated on request. Python 3.11+, runs on a
  Raspberry Pi, plugin system for trajectory and event sources. MIT licensed.
- [rittenregistratie-homeassistant](https://github.com/eduelias/rittenregistratie-homeassistant):
  Home Assistant plugin for the bot: when the car's ignition goes off, Home Assistant
  posts odometer and position and the trip is logged automatically.
- [famulus](https://github.com/eduelias/famulus): Self-hosted personal AI
  assistant on WhatsApp. FastAPI webhook on the official WhatsApp Business
  Cloud API (HMAC-verified), agent loop over a local LLM via Ollama, built-in
  web search (self-hosted SearXNG) and weather (Open-Meteo). Actions that send,
  publish or change state are gated behind owner confirmation. Plugin ecosystem
  via Python entry points: Gmail, Outlook, Home Assistant, LinkedIn, Overseerr,
  budget, shell and more. Apache-2.0.
- [freebell-bk7258](https://github.com/eduelias/freebell-bk7258): Open
  firmware for the Tuya "Smart Visual Doorbell" (Beken BK7258, board
  IP108_MAIN_V05) that shipped without a Tuya licence and could never be
  paired. Built on Beken's open Armino SDK: ring/motion webhooks to Home
  Assistant, RTSP H.264 video, full-duplex audio with echo cancellation,
  deep sleep on battery, microSD, OTA updates with a boot-loop rescue mode,
  and a board-profile layer for other BK7258 boards, with a simulator and CI
  tests. In daily use by the author since October 2026. Reverse-engineered
  from the stock flash image. Apache-2.0. Not affiliated with Tuya or Beken.
- [nucleus-job-plugin](https://github.com/eduelias/nucleus-job-plugin):
  Unofficial Rust runner for AWS IoT Jobs on Greengrass v2 devices. Executes
  allow-listed job handlers and reports status, reaching IoT Core through the
  Greengrass nucleus's own MQTT connection. Ships as a generic Greengrass
  component. Not affiliated with Amazon.
- [greengrass-ipc](https://github.com/eduelias/greengrass-ipc): Pure-Rust
  async client for AWS IoT Greengrass v2 component IPC (Unix-domain-socket
  eventstream). No C/FFI; tokio-based; implements operations the official
  bindings lack. On crates.io as `greengrass-ipc`. Not affiliated with Amazon.
- [bucket-search](https://github.com/eduelias/bucket-search): TypeScript npm
  package (`@eduelias/bucket-search`) that runs SQL queries across entire S3
  buckets via S3 Select, sequentially or simultaneously. MIT licensed.
- [gha-vacuum](https://github.com/eduelias/gha-vacuum): GitHub Action that
  runs the vacuum OpenAPI linter on API specs in CI. MIT licensed.
- [docker-jupyter-opencv](https://github.com/eduelias/docker-jupyter-opencv):
  Zero-setup Docker container with Jupyter and OpenCV for students; one script,
  works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. MIT licensed.
- [valheim-character-worlds](https://github.com/eduelias/valheim-character-worlds):
  Client-side BepInEx mod for Valheim that shows, on the character select screen,
  every world a character has played (explored area, beds, deaths). On Thunderstore.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://du7.dev/privacy): covers du7.dev and the Du7 AI Assistant
  WhatsApp bot. Self-hosted; the language model runs on own hardware, so message
  content is not sent to any third-party AI provider. No cookies or analytics on the
  site. Controller: Du7 Technology Services (KVK 91476003, Netherlands).
  rrbot.nl and Pauta publish their own terms and privacy pages.
